description: Department of Local Government - Western Province - Re appointed Deputy Chairman, S. K. R. Nishantha for the Peliyagoda Urban Council From 12.01.2023
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the reappointment of a Deputy Chairman for the Peliyagoda Urban Council, made under the provisions of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically relates to an electoral process appointment at the local government level, falling clearly under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) which includes electoral commission appointments and decisions.
